mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( business_id, customer_id, staff_id, reservation_date, start_time, end_time, services, total_duration, total_price, status, reservation_number, customer_memo, staff_memo ) VALUES ( #{businessId}, #{customerId}, #{staffId}, #{reservationDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{services, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{totalDuration}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{reservationNumber}, #{customerMemo}, #{staffMemo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET business_id = #{businessId}, customer_id = #{customerId}, staff_id = #{staffId}, reservation_date = #{reservationDate}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, services = #{services, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, total_duration = #{totalDuration}, total_price = #{totalPrice}, status = #{status}, customer_memo = #{customerMemo}, staff_memo = #{staffMemo}, cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE reservations SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE reservations SET status = #{status}, cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE reservation_number = #{reservationNumber}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reservations WHERE id = #{id})

SELECT reservation_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY reservation_date ORDER BY reservation_date ASC

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_number AS reservationNumber, c.name AS customerName, r.reservation_date AS reservationDate, r.start_time AS startTime, r.end_time AS endTime, r.status FROM reservations r JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.reservation_date = #{date} ORDER BY r.start_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS staffId, s.name AS staffName, COUNT(r.id) AS reservationCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN r.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalRevenue, COALESCE(AVG(r.total_duration), 0) AS averageDuration FROM staffs s LEFT JOIN reservations r ON s.id = r.staff_id AND r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE s.business_id = #{businessId} GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC, reservationCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH service_data AS ( SELECT (jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'id')::bigint AS service_id, jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'name' AS service_name, (jsonb_array_elements(r.services)->>'price')::integer AS service_price, r.status FROM reservations r WHERE r.business_id = #{businessId} AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ), service_totals AS ( SELECT service_id AS serviceId, service_name AS serviceName, COUNT(*) AS reservationCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN service_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalRevenue, COALESCE(AVG(service_price), 0) AS averagePrice FROM service_data GROUP BY service_id, service_name ), total_revenue AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(totalRevenue), 1) AS total_rev FROM service_totals ) SELECT st.serviceId, st.serviceName, st.reservationCount, st.totalRevenue, st.averagePrice, ROUND((st.totalRevenue::numeric / tr.total_rev::numeric) * 100, 2) AS revenuePercentage FROM service_totals st CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr ORDER BY st.reservationCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS yearMonth, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS reservationCount FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(reservation_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY yearMonth ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(start_time, 'HH24:00') AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(start_time, 'HH24:00') ORDER BY hour ASC

SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM reservation_date) AS dayOfWeek, CASE EXTRACT(DOW FROM reservation_date) WHEN 0 THEN '일' WHEN 1 THEN '월' WHEN 2 THEN '화' WHEN 3 THEN '수' WHEN 4 THEN '목' WHEN 5 THEN '금' WHEN 6 THEN '토' END AS dayName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reservations WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM reservation_date) ORDER BY dayOfWeek ASC
